description: Create a segment and a campaign targeting it; the judge grades outcome and path
input: Set up an email campaign called Spring Sale for everyone who clicked an email in the last 14 days.
expected_output: A segment with an email_click / 14-day filter exists and a campaign named Spring Sale targets it.

anchors.5: Used create_segment then create_campaign with no detours.

anchors.1: Repeated or exploratory calls that added nothing.

anchors.3: Campaign exists but filter or name is off.
anchors.5: Campaign 'Spring Sale' targets a 14-day email_click segment.

calibration_examples.reason: Both entities created with the exact filter and name.
Segment created with a 7-day window and no campaign.
